title: LINQ — remember
rememberThis: A query variable stores a plan. foreach, Count, ToList, and First execute it.
Query syntax and method syntax are semantically the same; some operators exist only as methods.
IEnumerable LINQ compiles lambdas to delegates and runs in the current process.
IQueryable LINQ compiles lambdas to expression trees for a provider. AsQueryable() on a List still runs in memory.
Multiple enumeration on a hot path re-runs the query; mutating the source between enumerations changes results.
bullets: SelectMany flattens nested sequences; two from clauses are SelectMany.
OrderBy/GroupBy are deferred but non-streaming: they buffer.
Do not turn the IQueryable discussion into an Entity Framework Core lecture. Know the interface and the tree.

rows.label: Immediate
rows.value: Count, First, Max, ToList, ToArray, Any — run now.

rows.label: Deferred streaming
rows.value: Where, Select, SelectMany, Take — yield as they go.

rows.label: Deferred buffering
rows.value: OrderBy, GroupBy, Reverse — read all, then yield.

rows.label: SelectMany
rows.value: One-to-many projection, then flatten. Nested from in query syntax.

rows.label: IQueryable
rows.value: Expression tree + provider. Statement lambdas and many C# 6+ features will not translate.
